## Scope check

recsys-lite is a deliberately narrow vertical slice. Please confirm:

- [ ] This sharpens the existing slice rather than turning it into a platform
- [ ] It does not add a new runtime dependency, or the PR will justify one
- [ ] It does not require a database server, message broker, orchestrator, or
      frontend build step

If it does require one of those, that is fine — say so explicitly and let's
discuss whether it belongs here or in a fork. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-what-this-project-is-not).
